standard.title: Comparing Observations with Predictions
standard.description: compare observations with predictions with guidance
standard.prior_knowledge: No formal prior science learning assumed.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students revisit predictions after observing, compare them with what they actually observed, and — with guidance — identify whether they matched or differed.

nodes.label: Predictions are compared with observations
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can revisit their prediction after an observation and say whether it matched, with teacher guidance.
nodes.minimum_width: Students compare one prediction with one observation and state whether they matched.
nodes.typical_width: Students revisit predictions and with guidance identify whether they matched observations; use a provided table to draw or dictate their prediction and observation; compare field work observations with pre-field predictions; and describe what was the same and what was different.
wider: Use a provided table to draw or dictate prediction and observation side by side — comparing explicitly
Revisit predictions about plant or animal field work observations and compare with what was actually found
Explore what to do when a prediction does not match — 'what can we do to find out more?'
success_criteria: States whether their prediction matched their observation
Describes at least one way the observation was the same as or different from the prediction
